method: Searched current Administration/Configuration, New Features/Release Notes, and architecture/deployment documentation for each mandatory product. Selected lesson topics are grounded in official feature/admin material; Community is scenario-only. Fortinet Document Library direct opens returned HTTP 403 for most sources, so indexed official document content and canonical URLs were used; this limitation is disclosed.
